scripts.prisma:db-pull: npm run with-env -- npx prisma db pull
scripts.prisma:db-push: npm run with-env -- npx prisma db push --skip-generate
scripts.prisma:init-migration: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate diff --from-empty --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script > prisma/migrations/0_init/migration.sql
scripts.prisma:resolve-migration: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate resolve --applied 0_init
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate dev --skip-generate --name
scripts.prisma:make-migration: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate dev --skip-generate --create-only --name
scripts.prisma:studio: npm run with-env -- npx prisma studio
scripts.prisma:deploy-migration: npm run with-env -- npx prisma migrate deploy
